mira: Nightly perf for TP 8xA100 run shows a sharp tail on all-reduce walltime starting ~step 1200, p99 ~3.6x the median. Pattern looks like periodic stalls every ~64 steps. cc @jon @sophia :eyes:
jon: Yikes. Any change in model config or batch mixing? small microbatching?
mira: No model change. We switched kernel-selector heuristics last week (auto-pad->aggressive-pad). Suspect padding/inflight window interaction. KV cache hit rate steady.
sophia: Can you paste an nsys timeline + nccl op sizes? Also which rendezvous (ring/tree) was used?
mira: nsys capture attached (trimmed):
```
NCCL AllReduce / step 1216: bytes=1.2MB, duration=1.8ms, backend=ring
NCCL AllReduce / step 1217: bytes=64KB, duration=0.5ms, backend=tree
NCCL AllReduce / step 1218: bytes=3.4MB, duration=4.9ms, backend=ring
...
Queue depth (inflight fragments): step 1216: 48, 1217: 6, 1218: 52
```
mira: Notice alternating big/small msg sizes correlated with TP+PP interleaving (microbatches crossing pipeline boundary).
kai: That fits a known pathological case: ring performs well for large contiguous messages but suffers when many small messages interleave; tree has higher startup cost but better for many small messages. The autoswitch heuristic may be using avg msg size and choosing ring, but instant distribution has bimodal sizes -> ring gets saturated.
jon: Can we tweak kernel-selector to consider msg-size variance and inflight-window fullness? E.g. prefer tree when (p90/p10 > 8 and inflight_windows > threshold).
sophia: I ran a quick sim with patched heuristic (pseudo):
```json
{"kernel_selector": "hybrid", "rule": "if msg_var_ratio>8 && inflight>32 then prefer=tree else prefer=ring"}
```
sophia: With that rule, nightly latency tail p99 dropped from 3.6x->1.4x median in my local 8GPU replay. Not perfect but promising.
mira: Nice. Also saw KV cache flush pattern: when tree chosen, KV-coalescing resulted in fewer small fragments (less padding), so cache hit spread improved latency.
kai: Two follow-ups: 1) add telemetry for per-step msg-size histogram so selector has short-window stats (not just aggregate). 2) add conservative backoff: if ring p99 spikes, force tree for next N steps.
jon: Agreed. Also need regression test: create microbatch-interleave replay harness that reproduces bimodal sizes so CI checks both selector rules and fallbacks.
devops-bot: perf-job-4521 finished: replay-8gpu-micro-interleave - logs in /mnt/perf/replays/4521/
mira: I'll open a draft PR with the heuristic + telemetry + a replay. Link shortly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
jon: If PR looks good, let's run dedicated night runs on dedicated infra (no oversub) to confirm throughput/cost impact.
mira: Will do. Adding action items in #eng-runtime board.
